description: Get one published listing by id. Owner contact is not included. weeklyPrice is the low end of the posted price converted to USD per week, and is null when the price is invalid. priceQuality is ok, unusual, or invalid (null when no price is posted). Unusual and invalid prices are unverified and are not typical rents; priceNote explains the check, and the owner can confirm the current price. likelyJobAd marks job posts, which are not rentals.
name: get_listing
title: Get listing details
